fixes.what_was_wrong: loadGameLeaderboard innerHTML'ga l.full_name va l.group_name (server-data) escapesiz qo'yardi (XSS). Faylda escHtml mavjud edi-yu, lekin zaif (null'da crash, " va ' escape qilmasdi).
fixes.what_changed: Mavjud escHtml student.html standartiga ko'tarildi (null-safe + " va ' escape; dublikat ta'rif qo'shilmadi). Leaderboard ${l.full_name} -> ${escHtml(l.full_name)}, ${l.group_name||''} -> ${escHtml(l.group_name||'')}. Qolgan innerHTML'lar server-data emas (statik savol banki / numeric / textContent), o'zgartirilmadi.
fixes.verification: node bilan haqiqiy fayldan ajratilgan escHtml ishga tushirildi: <,>,",',& neytrallandi, null='' . escHtml bir marta aniqlangan (grep tasdiqladi).

fixes.what_was_wrong: Hech qanday escape helper yo'q edi. Student list (full_name, group_name, mars_id), student detail (full_name, username, phone, mars_id, group_name, last_active), leaderboard (full_name, group_name), audit logs (action, target, details) server-data'ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri innerHTML'ga qo'yardi.
fixes.what_changed: <script> boshiga standart escHtml helper qo'shildi. Sanab o'tilgan barcha server-data ${...} interpolatsiyalari escHtml(...) bilan o'raldi. Group select <option value> ham escape qilindi.
fixes.verification: node bilan haqiqiy fayldan escHtml ajratib tekshirildi (XSS payload neytrallandi, null-safe). escHtml/escJsAttr har biri bir marta aniqlangan.

fixes.what_was_wrong: Referral form (ochiq/auth talab qilmaydigan endpointdan keladi) full_name, location, phone, interests, age, reject_reason, group_name, mars_id, group_time, teacher_name, referrer_user_id, created_at qiymatlarini escapesiz innerHTML'ga qo'yardi — eng yuqori xavfli XSS vektor.
fixes.what_changed: Barcha referral-card server-data interpolatsiyalari escHtml(...) bilan o'raldi (typeBadge va day_type statik, tegmadim).
fixes.verification: Grep bilan har bir maydon escHtml ostida ekanligi tasdiqlandi; template literal qavslar buzilmagan.

fixes.what_was_wrong: Single-quoted inline onclick ichidagi dinamik string (onclick="_studentFilter='${g}';..." va confirmApproveRef(${id},'${g}')). O'zbek guruh/ismlarida apostrof (O'quvchi, G'ayrat) handlerni buzar va attribute-injection imkonini berardi.
fixes.what_changed: escJsAttr helper qo'shildi: avval JS-string kontekst (\\ va ' uchun backslash-escape), so'ng HTML-attribute kontekst (escHtml). Ikkala onclick argumenti escJsAttr bilan o'raldi.
fixes.verification: node: escJsAttr("O'zbek<b>") => O\'zbek<b> — JS-string ham, attribute ham xavfsiz.

fixes.what_was_wrong: esc() helper apostrofni escape qilmasdi; href="${tgUrl}" (s.username'dan) va avatar first-letter innerHTML'lar (student/attendance/messages kartalari) escapesiz edi; mars_id single-quoted onclick'ga escapesiz uzatilardi.
fixes.what_changed: esc() ga .replace(/'/g,''') qo'shildi. Inline onclick mars_id argumentlari uchun escJsAttr helper qo'shildi (esc() ustiga JS-string escape). href="${esc(tgUrl)}". Uch avatar first-letter konteksti esc(...) bilan o'raldi (textContent ishlatadigan 1489/1628 tegilmadi).
fixes.verification: node: esc("O'zbek")=>O'zbek; escJsAttr ishladi. esc/escJsAttr har biri bir marta aniqlangan.

fixes.what_was_wrong: loadHomework ${hw.group_name} (server-data) escapesiz innerHTML'ga qo'yilardi (qolgan joylar allaqachon escHtml ishlatardi).
fixes.verification: Grep: hw.group_name endi escHtml ostida; boshqa hw.group_name interpolatsiyasi yo'q.
